summary: @servicetitan/assist-ui preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory and then invokes `bun math_init.js` via execFileSync against a 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js uses string-array rotation with a shift function, a large encoded constants table, a custom base-alphabet decoder, hex-mangled identifiers, and `with` blocks that defeat strict-mode static analysis. The package advertises itself as a React UI component library and has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a math-named install-time payload. package.json declares `"files": ["src", "lib", "package.json"]`, yet setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root outside the declared file list, inconsistent with the maintainer's normal publish surface for this scope. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute obfuscated bundled code at install time gives whoever published this version arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
